    Lemma 8.9: representation transfer along a functor with a bimodule retraction #

    local-ray-geometry.tex (lem:representation-transfer): "Let F : S → B be a functor between finite categories. Let B_F be the category with the objects of S and morphisms B_F(x, y) = B(Fx, Fy), so that F gives a functor S → B_F, which we assume injective on morphisms. Suppose that there is an S-bimodule map π : B_F → S retracting this inclusion. If B is representation-finite, then so is S."

    Finite k-linear categories are given by finite families of objects (CatAlg.Alg): S by FS : ι → 𝒮 and B by FB : κ → ℬ; the functor is a k-linear functor G : 𝒮 ⥤ ℬ with G (FS i) = FB (σ i). B_F is the family G ∘ FS = FB ∘ σ, representation-finite by repeated labels (isRepresentationFinite_comp: an idempotent corner of a Morita equivalent algebra); G embeds S into B_F (funcAlgHom), and Lemma 4.6 (splitRepresentationTransfer_of) applies to the retraction (representationTransfer).
